title: Derivative of a product with an independent factor
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $q,r$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be a coordinate. If changing coordinate $i$ to either sign leaves $q$ unchanged, then for every point $x$ of the cube, the discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of the pointwise product $qr$ at $x$ equals $q(x)$ times the discrete derivative of $r$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $q,r$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$q$ is unchanged when coordinate $i$ is set to any sign
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
